text_blocks.snippet: To prevent bird flu, focus on avoiding contact with infected birds, practicing good hygiene, and ensuring proper food safety. This includes maintaining distance from wild or domestic birds, washing hands frequently, and cooking poultry and eggs thoroughly.
snippet_highlighted_words: avoiding contact with infected birds, practicing good hygiene, and ensuring proper food safety

text_blocks.snippet: Here's a more detailed breakdown of preventative measures:

list.title: Minimize contact with wild birds:
list.snippet: Maintain a safe distance from wild birds, especially in areas where they gather or where there has been a bird flu outbreak.

list.title: Avoid visiting poultry farms or markets:
list.snippet: If visits are necessary, wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) and avoid touching birds.

list.title: Limit contact with sick or dead birds:
list.snippet: If you find a sick or dead bird, avoid touching it and report it to local authorities.

list.title: Wash hands frequently:
list.snippet: Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water for at least 15 seconds, especially after contact with birds, their droppings, or potentially contaminated surfaces.
